scope: Final static review of exact archived-endpoint replay and added object-level readouts; no optimizer or numeric tests rerun

checks.check: Syntax of runner, readout, metadata, common helpers and runtime
Exact archive endpoint by historical update pair and condition replaces naive theta+delta
Each endpoint retains initial vector, FP32 difference and full old-model SHA assertions
CPU endpoint audit validates 27 archive endpoints against old complete-model SHA and old FP32 delta bytes
Each condition reloads F2304 full state before parameter substitution, without accumulation
Runner invokes neither backward/autograd.grad nor optimizer.step; forward/risk/measurement run under no_grad
Original complete Adam state hash, initial model hash, parameter order, old initial RNG and inputs/cohort hashes are verified
Frozen frontend, BN, RNG and untouched optimizer/None gradients checked before COMPLETE
Every old baseline, old update readout and unchanged-pair observer readout must exactly reproduce prior stored metrics
Legacy aggregate readouts reused unchanged; detail only adds original fixed-cohort per-object values and positions
Weak margin preserves FP32 qpositive-qnegative before Python conversion; qnegative retains original fixed ROI risk result
Source/video-scoped track identities, uncertain reliable identities and scoped background reference IDs retained
negative_reference_indices no longer overwrites scoped negative_reference_ids
Runner writes only new pair/shard outputs and aborts if a destination already exists
Freeze manifest verified before and after each shard; root must include endpoint archive and review sources in final freeze

resolved_findings: Naive FP32 initial+delta replaced by exact whole-model-hash-verified archive endpoints.
Scoped negative_reference_ids preserved by separate negative_reference_indices field.
limits: Static PASS does not claim GPU replay completed; exact baseline/endpoint readout assertions remain runtime gates.
